speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To begin my assessment, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if the pain is located on the right or left side of your abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) with possible concurrent Urinary Tract Infection.
